instruction: Take a snapshot from the video and ensure it's saved in PNG format

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires taking a snapshot with PNG format. VLC default snapshot format is PNG. Steps: 1) Take snapshot in VLC (Video->Take Snapshot). Evaluator uses 'file' command to verify the snapshot is in PNG format.
